rules.paymentsIncluded: Payments & Back-End Integration is included with Booked & Paid, Business Site Essentials, and every website package above it. It is not included with Own Your .com.
rules.promoCodes: Promotion codes (for example YOBUL) apply only to items with promoEligible true. Starter-line items are fixed prices and are excluded.
rules.flatVsStarting: priceMode flat = a fixed template product at that price. priceMode starting_at = the entry price of a scoped build; a written scope confirms the final price.
rules.thirdParty: Stripe processing fees, Google subscriptions, and domain renewals after year one are separate unless an item says otherwise.
rules.campaigns: Ads read price and name from this file through scripts/campaign-brief.mjs. Never put a price in an ad that this file and /pricing do not show.

lines.name: Own Your Name
lines.audience: Solo pros and creators: barbers, stylists, lash techs, braiders, musicians
lines.summary: Template sites at fixed prices, built on your own .com. Keep the booking app you already use.

lines.name: Business Websites
lines.audience: Businesses that need a custom-designed site
lines.summary: Custom design and build, scoped in writing before work begins.

lines.name: Software and Automation
lines.audience: Businesses replacing manual work with software
lines.summary: Applications, integrations, dashboards, and AI workflows built around one defined requirement.

lines.name: Care Plans
lines.audience: Clients with a live site or system
lines.summary: Recurring upkeep, changes, and cloud review.

items.name: Own Your .com
items.description: Your own .com with a home page and a services page that sends clients to the booking link you already use.
includes: Home page and services page from a Fee The Developer template
Book Now button to your current booking link
you@yourdomain.com email forwarding to your inbox
Launch after you approve a preview link
items.scopeNote: Template build, two pages, client-supplied text and photos. Domain renewal after year one, a full mailbox, payments on the site, and custom design are separate.

campaign.audience: Barbers, stylists, lash techs, braiders and musicians whose link is a booking-app or link-in-bio URL
campaign.pain: Their link carries a platform name, not theirs
campaign.hook: Your booking link has someone else's name in it.

items.name: Booked & Paid
items.description: Your own site with booking and payments that land in your own Stripe account.
includes: Deposits and payments on your own Stripe account
Pay-over-time options where Stripe supports them
items.scopeNote: Template build, up to four pages, one booking tool, one Stripe account. Stripe processing fees are separate. Custom design is a Business Website.

campaign.audience: Solo pros losing money to no-shows and DM payments
campaign.pain: Empty chairs and chasing payments by message
campaign.hook: An empty chair is money you already counted.

items.name: Shop Bundle
items.description: One shop site on the shop's .com, plus a page for each barber or stylist.
includes: Shop site on the shop's .com, first year included
Up to four barber or stylist pages
Each chair's own Book Now button
items.scopeNote: Starting scope covers four chairs. Each additional chair is the Shop Bundle Extra Chair item.

campaign.audience: Barbershop and salon owners with booth renters
campaign.pain: Every chair books through a different link
campaign.hook: One site for the shop. A page for every chair.

items.name: Keep-Live
items.description: Keeps a Starter site live: domain renewal, hosting, and two text or price updates a year.
includes: Two text or price updates a year
items.scopeNote: Applies to Own Your .com, Booked & Paid, and Shop Bundle sites. Design changes and new pages are separate.

items.name: Get Paid Button
items.description: A Stripe pay button on a Starter site for one deposit, product, or gift card.
items.scopeNote: One Stripe Payment Link on the client's own Stripe account. Full checkout, webhooks, and back-office work are Payments & Back-End Integration.

items.name: Get Found on Google
items.description: Google Business Profile basics for a solo pro, linked to their .com.
items.scopeNote: Profile claim and basic details for one solo pro. Google controls verification; multi-location and service-area alignment are the business add-ons.

items.name: Pro Inbox Setup
items.description: A full send-and-receive mailbox at your .com on Google Workspace.
items.scopeNote: One mailbox. Google bills its Workspace subscription to the client separately.

items.name: Extra Page
items.description: One more template page on a Starter site, such as a gallery or an about page.
items.scopeNote: One template page with client-supplied text and photos.

items.name: Shop Bundle Extra Chair
items.description: One more barber or stylist page on a Shop Bundle site.
items.scopeNote: One chair page with its own Book Now button.

items.name: Business Site Essentials
items.description: A custom-designed site of up to five pages for a business ready to move past a template.
includes: Up to five pages, custom design
Mobile-first build with accessibility and performance checks
items.scopeNote: About 14 engineering hours at the $175/hour estimating rate. Supplied content, one contact or booking path. Profiles, CRM, and e-commerce are separate.

campaign.audience: Small businesses on an outdated template or no site
campaign.pain: The business grew and the website did not
campaign.hook: Your business grew. Your website didn't.

items.name: Website Launch
items.description: A professional, mobile-ready website for a business that needs a polished, conversion-focused web presence.
items.scopeNote: Midpoint of published $3,000–$8,000 DFW professional small-business build range. Custom mobile-ready marketing site with agreed pages, supplied content, contact path, accessibility/performance checks, and launch QA.

campaign.audience: Established local businesses that need a polished custom site
campaign.pain: First impressions happen online before they walk in
campaign.hook: First impressions happen before the first visit.

items.name: Digital Presence Bundle
items.description: A website plus coordinated setup across the business profiles customers search first.
includes: Google, Apple, and Yelp presence setup
items.scopeNote: Website Launch plus a defined set of business-profile setup/alignment tasks. State exact included profiles and business locations.

campaign.audience: Local service businesses customers cannot find online
campaign.hook: You do great work. The problem is being found.

items.name: Strategic Website Redesign
items.description: A scoped redesign of an existing business site.
items.scopeNote: Starting point for a scoped redesign; migration, content writing, complex integrations, and e-commerce priced separately.

items.name: E-commerce or Custom Website Features
items.description: Online stores and custom website functionality.
items.scopeNote: Starting point for custom functionality; payment-provider fees, inventory, tax/shipping setup, and vendor plans excluded.

items.name: Business Website Design & Development
items.description: Retired: duplicated Website Launch at the same $5,500 price.
items.scopeNote: Retired 2026-11 pricing v2. Sold as Website Launch.

items.name: Custom Software & Automation
items.description: Custom applications, dashboards, integrations, and AI workflows built around a defined business requirement.
includes: One defined application or automation scope
items.scopeNote: 20 engineering hours × $175/hour. Discovery confirms the feature list; client approves more time before work exceeds the starting allowance.

campaign.audience: Operators and teams repeating manual work
campaign.pain: People doing work software should do
campaign.hook: Some work should not need a person every time.

items.name: Full Business System
items.description: A coordinated digital launch combining website development, business presence, automation, and integrations.
items.scopeNote: Midpoint of published $5,000–$15,000+ custom-feature/e-commerce range. Entry scope is one website plus one defined workflow/integration.

campaign.audience: Owners scaling past a patchwork of tools
campaign.hook: At some point the business needs a system, not more tools.

items.name: Lead Capture & CRM Automation
items.description: One lead flow into one CRM with notifications.
items.scopeNote: One defined lead flow into one CRM, basic notifications, testing, and handoff. CRM licenses, marketing campaigns, and multi-stage automation excluded.

items.name: API Integration Setup
items.description: One documented API connected to one defined data flow.
items.scopeNote: One documented API and one defined data flow. API access approval, vendor fees, rate limits, and work beyond the agreed endpoint/data scope are separate.

items.name: AI Assistant / Chatbot Setup
items.description: One bounded AI assistant use case with approved knowledge sources.
items.scopeNote: One bounded use case, approved knowledge sources, safety/fallback behavior, and testing. Model usage, hosting, and content moderation guarantees excluded.

items.name: Clerk + Supabase Completion
items.description: Finish sign-in and database access rules on an existing Clerk + Supabase app.
items.scopeNote: Estimate at $175/hour, 20 hours. Environment check, defined sign-in/sign-up flow, database access rules for agreed user types, basic flow tests, and handoff.

items.name: Business Analytics Dashboard
items.description: One dashboard over agreed data sources and measures.
items.scopeNote: One defined dashboard with agreed data sources and measures. Source-system access, paid BI tools, and additional connectors excluded.

items.name: Custom Public-Data Collection Tool
items.description: A tool that collects permitted public data on a schedule.
items.scopeNote: Only publicly accessible, permitted data sources or approved APIs. No login bypass, anti-bot evasion, or collection of sensitive personal data.

items.name: Payments & Back-End Integration
items.description: Payments on your own Stripe account, connected to the systems behind your business. Included with Booked & Paid, Business Site Essentials, and every website package above it.
items.scopeNote: Stripe processing fees are separate and paid to Stripe. The existing Stripe product is found by its catalog_slug metadata.

items.name: Yelp Profile Setup or Cleanup
items.description: One Yelp profile set up or cleaned up.
items.scopeNote: One profile, information cleanup, and handoff. Reviews, ranking, ads, and platform decisions are not guaranteed.

items.name: Apple Business Connect Setup
items.description: One business location set up on Apple Business Connect.
items.scopeNote: One business/location setup, subject to Apple account ownership and review.

items.name: GA4 Property Review / Audit
items.description: A review of an existing GA4 property with prioritized fixes.
items.scopeNote: Existing client-owned property required; findings and prioritized fixes. Does not include implementation.

items.name: Google Business Profile Setup & Verification Support
items.description: Business Profile setup with owner-guided verification support.
items.scopeNote: Setup and owner-guided verification support; Google controls verification and approval. No guarantee of profile approval or ranking.

items.name: Google Workspace & Business Email Setup
items.description: Workspace and business email for one domain.
items.scopeNote: One domain and agreed mailbox/user configuration. Google subscriptions, migration, and domain charges are separate.

items.name: Contact, Category, Location & Service-Area Alignment
items.description: Consistent business details across up to three profiles.
items.scopeNote: Up to three client-selected profiles; additional locations/platforms quoted separately.

items.name: GA4 Setup & Validation
items.description: A new or reset GA4 property with agreed events and validation.
items.scopeNote: New or reset property, measurement plan, agreed events/conversions, validation, and handoff. Custom checkout tracking is separately scoped.

items.name: Website Maintenance & Support
items.description: Routine updates, backup checks, and support intake for a business site.
items.scopeNote: Routine agreed updates, backup checks, basic availability/security checks, and support intake. No included feature-development hours.

items.name: Cloud Management
items.description: Monthly billing, deployment, backup, and access review with a short report.
items.scopeNote: Vendor bills, 24/7 monitoring, incident response labor, and remediation are separate unless written into scope.

items.name: Public-Data Monitoring & Change Alerts
items.description: Scheduled checks of a written source list with change alerts.
items.scopeNote: Limited source list and check cadence in writing. Hosting/API/notification fees separate; no change-detection guarantee for third-party sites.

items.name: Developer Change Block
items.description: Three hours a month of requested changes.
items.scopeNote: Three hours of requested code/content/configuration changes at the $175/hour estimating rate. No rollover unless stated in the client agreement.

items.name: Fee Developer Protection
items.description: Site care, three hours of changes, and a monthly cloud and security review.
items.scopeNote: Protection reduces risk; it does not guarantee security or uninterrupted service.
